about: DateInput — a date someone already knows, in three short fields. Day, month and year in a fieldset whose legend is the question, each with its own small label, sized to its answer (two, two and four c

legend.about: The question: "What is your date of birth?".

hint.about: An example in the order the fields come: "For example, 27 3 2007".

errorParts.about: The parts in error, which alone take the error border. All of them when left out and there is an error.

parts.about: Which parts to ask for: day, month and year, or month and year for a date people only know roughly.

order.about: Day first (most of the world) or month first (the US).

monthAs.about: The month as a text field, or as a select of month names (easier for some; the names come from monthNames).

birthday.about: It is the reader's own date of birth: the fields say so to autofill (bday-day, bday-month, bday-year).

id.about: The parts' ids are `${id}-day`, `${id}-month`, `${id}-year`: link an ErrorSummary to the first part in error.

name.about: The parts' names are `${name}-day` and so on.
